title: Art Director
description:
Digixito Group has always been in the spotlight for being adept in the next big technologies. What we can offer you is a space to explore varied technologies and quench your techie soul.

The Art Director will be responsible for the day\-to\-day tasks associated with creative direction, branding, art direction, graphics, and graphic design

**Role:** Art Director

**Experience:** 5\+ Years

**Location:** Noida

**Desired Competencies (Technical / Behavioral Competency)\-Must\-Have**

· Working from the brief with a copy writer or other members of a creative team, generating ideas to present to the client.

· Conceptualize and develop creative strategies for both mainline and digital  
advertising campaigns, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and target audience.

· Brainstorming for concepts and ideas on own and with team members as well.

· Work well as part of a team with a range of people.

· Lead the design team in the creation of visual assets, including but not limited to print  
ads, digital banners, social media graphics, website layouts, and video content.

· Provide creative direction and guidance to team members, ensuring that designs meet  
quality standards and project requirements.

· Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in design  
and advertising, and integrate innovative ideas into projects.

· Participate in client meetings to understand their goals, provide creative recommendations, and present design concepts effectively.

· Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines while  
maintaining high\-quality standards.

· Work closely with the account management team to ensure client satisfaction and  
address feedback and revisions promptly.

· Conduct regular performance evaluations for team members, provide constructive  
feedback, and support their professional development.

· Uphold brand guidelines and ensure that all creative work reflects the brand's identity,  
values, and messaging.

**Required skill set:**

· Highly creative with ability to develop new design concepts and idea based communication.

· Knowledge of graphic design tools, typography and printing. Drawing/illustration skills, photograph, motion\-graphics skills would be an extra plus.

· Knowledge of Software skills at least in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign

· Should have good time management skills, with experience in working with tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

· A passion for advertising and commercial art.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writer and Social Media Manager
Technical Content Writer
description:
**About Meon Technologies**

Meon Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing IT company specializing in innovative digital solutions such as eKYC, Aadhaar eSign, chatbot development, and other digital transformation solutions.

We help businesses streamline identity verification and communication through secure, paperless, and compliant digital processes. With a strong focus on technology, innovation, and customer\-centric solutions, we are building the future of digital transformation.

We are urgently looking for a Technical Content Writer who is passionate about writing and can simplify complex technical concepts into clear, engaging, and user\-friendly content. **Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Create high\-quality technical content for websites, blogs, articles, and digital platforms.
* Write clear, informative, and engaging content based on technical topics and products.
* Develop SEO\-optimized content to improve organic traffic and search engine rankings.
* Conduct research on technology trends, industry developments, and relevant topics.
* Convert complex technical information into easy\-to\-understand content.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Technical teams to understand content requirements.
* Create and maintain content aligned with the company's brand voice and communication guidelines.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure accuracy, clarity, grammar, and consistency.
* Optimize existing content for SEO, readability, engagement, and search performance.
* Ensure all published content is original, well\-researched, and factually accurate.
* Stay updated with the latest SEO practices, content trends, and technology developments.

**Key Skills**

* Technical Writing
* Content Writing
* SEO Writing
* Blog \& Article Writing
* Web Content Writing
* Research \& Content Development
* Proofreading \& Editing
* Excellent English Communication
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals

**Eligibility**

* Any Graduate.
* Candidates must have strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Candidates currently pursuing any degree, certification, course, or other studies are not eligible.
* Candidates with relevant experience in technical content writing and SEO content writing will be preferred.
* Immediate joiners are preferred.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
